reasoning: Identity (EO 13900 of December 17, 2019, 84 FR 69983-69984, FR Doc. 2019-27678, Trump, closing on December 24, 2019), quotes, hashes, clause inventory, own-terms analysis, savings, and the description of the held citers (the four 2021-2022 notices miscite EO 13990 as 13900) all check out against the sources.
